raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Customers migrated to the new CRM on 2026-01-15 carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names, and silver_customers passes them through unmapped. raw_region_map is complete (one row per code, covering all four codes) and documents the translation, so these customers' regions in gold_region_daily can be corrected deterministically.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(coalesce(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = trim(m.region_code)"}}
